page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.32xlarge is a large-scale, general-purpose cloud instance configured to support high-concurrency parallel computing. Built on the KVM hypervisor, this virtual machine runs on the x86_64 architecture using AMD EPYC 7T83 processors. The instance delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs with a nominal base frequency of 2.55 GHz. Memory allocation is scaled to match the extensive core count, providing 512 GB of RAM at an even ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. This balanced core-to-memory relationship prevents resource contention during multi-threaded processing.

For input/output and inter-node communication, the instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. A key architectural characteristic is the lack of local disk storage; the instance contains 0 GB of integrated storage and no discrete hardware accelerators such as GPUs. All storage operations rely entirely on external network-attached storage devices. Systems engineers must budget for appropriate remote block storage throughput and latency configurations to prevent network-attached volumes from bottle-necking the high processing capacity of 128 dedicated cores.

From a hardware utilization and qualitative efficiency standpoint, consolidating workloads onto this 128-vCPU instance reduces multi-instance management overhead and maximizes compute density per operating system deployment. Because the instance type balances dedicated AMD processing power with substantial memory rather than high-cost local NVMe or GPU hardware, it provides an economical profile for general large-scale execution. The ecs.g7a.32xlarge is well fitted for enterprise databases, big data batch analytics, high-traffic web application tiers, and distributed continuous integration pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.32xlarge is a high-density, general-purpose virtual machine deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by 128 dedicated AMD EPYC 7T83 vCPUs running at 2.55 GHz and is paired with 512 GB of system memory, maintaining a 4 GB per vCPU distribution. Networking capabilities include a 32 Gbps baseline throughput, supporting high-volume inter-service communications. The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes to handle persistent file storage and state management. Without local NVMe drives or discrete GPU acceleration, the hardware profile prioritizes dense, multi-threaded CPU parallelization and broad memory capacity. In terms of resource efficiency, the large core count and uniform resource distribution provide solid cost-performance characteristics for consolidated multi-tenant services. The ecs.g7a.32xlarge is suited for memory-aware compute workloads, extensive enterprise resource planning systems, large distributed databases, and high-concurrency web serving applications.
